Consider the graphs of \(y=\sin(x)\) and \(y=\cos(x)\).
You can adjust the position of \(\theta\) (green point) in the diagram below.

From the diagram: {@if funcA="sin" then "
\\(\\sin(\\theta) = \\cos(90-\\theta) = \\sin(180-\\theta) = \\sin(360+\\theta)\\)" else "
\\(\\cos(\\theta) = \\cos(-\\theta) = \\sin(90-\\theta) = \\cos(360+\\theta)\\)"@}

Also: {@if funcA="sin" then "
\\(-\\sin(\\theta) = \\sin(\\theta \\pm 180) = \\sin(-\\theta)\\)
\\(\\Rightarrow \\sin(\\theta) = -\\sin(\\theta \\pm 180) = -\\sin(-\\theta)\\)" else "
\\(-\\cos(\\theta) = \\cos(\\theta \\pm 180) = \\cos(180-\\theta)\\)
\\(\\Rightarrow \\cos(\\theta) = -\\cos(\\theta \\pm 180) = -\\cos(180-\\theta)\\)"@}

These are the 5 correct solutions.
